sources: Hit structure: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0034_typhoea_* (game 1.6). Projectile and ability-entity hits take their parent's blackboard (LaunchProjectile / SpawnAbilityEntity assignBlackboard) and split it with SimpleCalcBBAction literals (operation 2 = ×, 3 = ÷): attack1 2 arrows × atk_scale/2; attack3 2 waves × atk_scale/2 (3 arrows per wave, one damages a target: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_attack_3_*_damagetaken gate); attack4 atk_scale×0.35 + 5 × atk_scale×0.13; battle skill 2 arrows × atk_scale×0.5; combo 7 arrows × atk_scale/7 and 18 ticks × atk_scale_persistent/18; ultimate sub-rains 3 ticks × atk_scale_outer/3 and 5 × atk_scale_center×0.08 + atk_scale_center×0.6.

The literals sum to 1 in every skill, so each skill's single-target total is its table value. Kits can't express a constant factor yet, so split hits are written here as one combined hit (count 1, frame of the first landing) with no log events: the per-arrow values can't be checked hit by hit until the kit format has a literal factor. The per-arrow values were checked with a scratch script implementing that factor (see each note).

Verification: fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json (P1, no Corrosion; all 43 Typhoeus hits reproduce within ±1 once the log checker (a) counts a stackingType-1 (highest-priority) buff such as buff_wpn_funnel_0016_will_dmg once, (b) applies damage-mask-conditioned buffs such as buff_chr_0034_typhoea_combo_enemy_debuff only to bursts (mask 33554432) and (c) tries boundary buffs one by one and (d) caps a buff's logged instances at its stack limit (buff_equipsuit_usp_02_AddAttack once; buff_equipsuit_spellburst_01_physpellup needs 3 instances to match, although its parent assigns max_stack 2: unexplained)), and fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json (P5) up to t=6119 (14 hits, Corrosion level 2). Later 0eef hits drift under Corrosion; fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json (parser v58) is short of a large unlogged buff on every Typhoeus hit (×1.54–1.9 after t=9605, probably Lizhiyan's buff_common_affixes_enhance_spell, logged only as a boundary buff at t=6098; ×1.1585 on the first hit at t=4415) and matches nothing.

Not in this kit, ~80% of his logged damage: his burst buff_common_natural_natural_triggered_typhoea, created by enhanced floating arrows (floating_attack1_01_projhit, floating_attack5_01_projhit). It is the standard Nature burst (ReadSkillSettingData 法术爆发伤害倍率) × damage_enhence = potential_damage_rate (P5: 1.1), × enchence_burst_damage_rate (1.3 at level 12) when the target had a Nature infliction for the arrow to consume. Verified on dbaee (×1.3 at t=9860, 11237; ×1.0 at t=8391, 14084–16501) and 0eef (×1.1, t=4426–5899). Needs engine support (a reaction hit with a skill-value multiplier).
Only ultimate_skillfloating is in CharGrowthTable's ultimate group (chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill is unused), so the ultimate always uses its values (atk_scale_outer 0.75 at level 12).

skills.label: Basic attack 1
skills.note: durationFrames: attack2 is allowed from frame 9 (AllowNextSkillAction; SkillData durationFrame 150).

hits.label: 2 arrows (combined)
hits.note: Two arrows launched at frames 5 and 8, each atk_scale/2, logged as chr_0034_typhoea_attack1_01_projhit. Per-arrow value matches fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json t=1644 and t=1776 (1269 each).

skills.label: Basic attack 2
skills.note: durationFrames: attack3 is allowed from frame 12 (SkillData durationFrame 182).

hits.note: One arrow; logged under attack1's event chr_0034_typhoea_attack1_01_projhit (same projectile skill), so it can't carry the event while attack1's half-value arrows share it. Matches fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json t=2719 (4958).

skills.label: Basic attack 3
skills.note: durationFrames: attack4 is allowed from frame 20 (SkillData durationFrame 185).

hits.label: 2 arrow waves (combined, single target)
hits.note: Waves of 3 arrows at frames 5–8 (attack3_01_projhit) and 14–17 (attack3_02_projhit), atk_scale/2 each; a target takes one arrow per wave. Per-wave value matches fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json t=2943 (3807). Several targets can take more.

skills.label: Basic attack 4
skills.note: durationFrames: attack5 is allowed from frame 27 (SkillData durationFrame 170). Not yet seen in a log.

hits.label: 6 arrows (combined)
hits.note: atk_scale×0.35 at frame 5 (attack4_01_projhit) and 5 × atk_scale×0.13 at frames 15, 18, 21, 24, 27 (attack4_02_projhit). Unverified.

skills.label: Basic attack 5 (final strike)
skills.note: durationFrames: attack1 is allowed from frame 46 (SkillData durationFrame 150). Not yet seen in a log.

hits.note: One arrow: attack5_01_projhit on a hit, or attack5_02_projhit on every target in range when the arrow is blocked. Unverified.

skills.label: Power attack
skills.note: durationFrames: battle and combo skills are allowed from frame 40 (SkillData durationFrame 180). Not yet seen in a log; the power_attack_projhit hit on reach (literal ×4, mask 132) is left out.

hits.note: The projectile casts attack5_01_projhit with this skill's blackboard. Unverified.

skills.label: Battle skill: take flight (opening volley)
skills.note: Enters the floating stance (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_floatingmode; from P1 it also carries buff_chr_0034_typhoea_potential_atkup, ATK +18%, which the logs list). durationFrames: floating_attack1 is allowed from frame 26 and cast automatically at frame 32 (SkillData durationFrame 40).

hits.label: 2 arrows (combined)
hits.note: normal_skill_attack1_projhit at frames 2–5 and normal_skill_attack2_projhit at 7–10, each atk_scale×0.5 (damage mask 256, battle skill). Per-arrow value matches fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json t=2485, 2595 and fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json t=3262, 3393.

skills.label: Floating shot (enhanced arrow)
skills.note: Floating stance shots use the battle skill's level but deal basic-attack damage (damageDecorateMask 128, as basic attacks). Each shot consumes one buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_num stack if there is one (enhanced arrow) and also creates his burst (see sources). durationFrames: the next shot is allowed from frame 18 of each 25-frame section and cast at 22 (SkillData durationFrame 160 holds 5 direction variants).

hits.note: floating_attack1_01_projhit: atk_scale_total = atk_scale_base × atk_scale_enhence (talent 1 sets 1.2/1.4/1.6; P1 ×1.2 on atk_scale_base). Matches all 7 floating hits in fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json and the first 4 in fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json (t=4073–6119, Corrosion level 2), all enhanced. No event: the current log checker over-counts buffs on the later hits (see sources).

skills.label: Floating shot (no arrow left)
skills.note: The same shot without an arrow stack: atk_scale_base only and no burst (it consumes one Nature infliction, if any, for usp_recover energy instead). Not yet seen in a log.

skills.label: Combo skill
skills.note: durationFrames: the battle skill is allowed from frame 48 (SkillData durationFrame 241). Also puts buff_chr_0034_typhoea_combo_enemy_debuff on the target: +persistent_naturalburst_increase burst damage taken (bursts only, mask 33554432; P3 +0.06).

hits.label: 7 arrows (combined)
hits.note: combo_01_projhit (1, frame 35) and combo_02_projhit (6, frames 40–52), atk_scale/7 each. Per-arrow value matches all 7 in fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json (t=10101–10781).

hits.label: Lingering area (18 ticks, combined)
hits.note: combo_persistentdamage ability entity spawned by the first arrow's hit: 18 ticks every 1/3 s (6 s) of atk_scale_persistent/18 while the target stays inside. Per-tick value matches all 12 in fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json.

skills.label: Combo skill (floating)
skills.note: Same arrows as the grounded combo skill; returns to the floating stance from frame 57 (SkillData durationFrame 70). Both log under the same event keys, so the logs don't tell which one was cast.

skills.label: Ultimate
skills.note: Spawns the arrow rain (chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill_arrowrain) at frame 61, which multiplies atk_scale_main/center/outer by potential_damge_up (P5 1.2) and passes them on. durationFrames: floating shots are allowed from frame 83 (SkillData durationFrame 92). Also gives arrow_num_given arrow stacks (P5 +1).

hits.label: Arrow rain, main hit
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain (damage at the entity's frames 1–3). Matches fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json t=13975 (103923, crit). fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json t=4415 (15716) is 15.85% above the prediction with no logged buffs; unexplained.

hits.label: Follow-up rain (3 ticks, combined)
hits.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill_cause_subarrowrain (5 s) spawns a follow-up rain on ability event 302 (0.2 s apart) up to 5 times: 4 × ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub1 (3 ticks of atk_scale_outer/3) then 1 × sub2. Needs Typhoeus to keep hitting during the 5 s, so fewer may land. Per-tick value matches all 7 in fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json.

hits.label: Final rain (6 ticks, combined)
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub2: 5 ticks of atk_scale_center×0.08 then one of atk_scale_center×0.6. Seen only in fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json (t=13829–14675): the implied multipliers 0.3017 (×5) and 2.2629 are 7.50 apart, as 0.6/0.08, but that log's missing buff hides the absolute value. Unverified.

skills.label: Plunging attack (landing)
skills.note: SkillData durationFrame (no earlier cancel window found). Not yet seen in a log.

hits.note: DamageAction at frames 0–4 (mask 1152); plunging_attack_end_projhit is an alternative landing hit with the same value. Unverified.
